appearances.snippet: And when I called Helan and asked why I couldn't eat there, she said, it's a Jewish country club. They're not Jewish. They're not going to serve you. They, honest to God, think their DNA is better than everybody else.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Current searches did not identify a reliable source establishing that generalized belief for the unspecified group.
